the damage in the composite stiffened plates will affect its dynamic responses, and the dynamic responses will be more sensitive to the damage when the frequency of the dynamic load is close to the natural frequency of the structure.
the dynamic responses of the stiffened composite plate with the delamination and matrix damage are affected by the damage location, damage extent and the dynamic load type.
the interaction between delamination and matrix’s damage has significant influence on the dynamic responses of stiffened composite laminates.

the dynamic analysis of a stiffened composite laminates plate, which is subjected to an imbedded delamiantion, and matrix damage.
the effect of matrix damage on dynamic characteristics of composite stiffened delaminated plates.
the dynamic characteristics of the stiffened composite plates with delamination damage, which is important for the design and manufacture of composite structures.

the damage in the composite laminates has a significant effect on the dynamic response.
this study provides an effective method to investigate the dynamic behavior of damaged stiffened composite laminates.

the delamination and matrix damage have significant effect on the natural frequency and dynamic response characteristics of the stiffened composite plate under dynamic loads, and the dynamic response of stiffened composite plate with delamination is different from the stiffened composite plates with matrix damage.

the stiffness and mass matrices derived based on the Mindlin plate theory are very effective to calculate the dynamic characteristics of the composite stiffened laminated plates.
the damage in the composite laminated stiffened plates is a very important problem and should be considered in the design and analysis of composite stiffened plates.
the damage of the matrix and the interaction of the delamination and matrix crack are two key factors that influence the dynamic response of a stiffened composite plate.

it is necessary to consider the damage effect of the stiffened composite plates when the dynamic response is analyzed.
the delamination and the micro-cracks have a strong influence on the dynamic responses of stiffened composite plates.
